Subject: Integration follow-up - SDK auth & 5xx repro

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning 

great to see the Finlytics use case for document reranking + structured extraction. Summary and next steps below so we have a clear mutual action plan.

Call recap (high level)
- Goal: embed + rerank for search + structured output for invoice extraction (vendor, total, due_date).
- Traffic profile: ~200 qps during peak, mostly short sequences (~256 tokens).
- SLA ask: p95 latency < 300ms for generation path, batch-friendly for embeddings.

Open technical items we agreed to investigate
1) SDK auth: Finlytics saw intermittent 5xx when using the JS SDK behind a proxy (we suspect header rewrite or HMAC mismatch).
2) Routing & fallbacks: need to validate routing policy for model variants between hosted and dedicated pools.
3) Structured output: confirm tool-calling schema for invoice extraction and ensure stable reranker scoring.
4) Repro steps: Alex to share request samples and logs (they said they can share a sanitized request payload).

Action items
- Alex: share sample request payload + timestamped logs (JSON). Attach to this thread when ready.
- Redwood (Camila / Neha / Dylan): attempt to repro 5xx using provided payloads, capture server-side logs and sampling ids, and propose mitigations (timeouts, retry policy, auth header handling).
- Marissa: coordinate next touchpoint after repro (target EOD tomorrow).

Attachments: example request-sample.json attached (sanitized).

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Integration follow-up - SDK auth & 5xx repro

Adding a quick triage summary from infra: we tried the sample payloads Alex sent in a local staging cluster and observed the following:

1) 5xx pattern: intermittent 502/500 originating from the edge LB when Authorization header size > 1024 bytes (Finlytics uses a long HMAC token with extra metadata in the header).
2) Reproducer: we could reproduce using the attached curl example (below). When we trim the header to a shorter token the call succeeds consistently.
3) Timeout config: their current client retry strategy sends 3 immediate retries on 5xx with no exponential backoff which overloaded a short-lived gateway error path.

Minimal repro curl (sanitized):
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d @request-sample.json

Next steps we recommend:
- Camila / Dylan: propose a mitigation plan to Finlytics:
  * Short-term: advise client to trim Authorization header or use token exchange (smaller ephemeral token) + server-side allowlist for proxy. Also add exponential backoff to their retries.
  * Medium-term: update edge LB to accept larger header sizes / normalize header passthrough for our proxy.
- Neha: collect sampling ids and correlate to edge logs (I attached repro-logs.txt with sampling ids).

Let me know if you want me to open a ticket to escalate LB config to infra ops.

- Neha
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration follow-up - SDK auth & 5xx repro

Hi Alex / Priya 

thanks for the quick turnaround and the logs. Based on Neha's repro we can move forward with two parallel tracks:

1) Short-term (hours):
- Please try swapping to an ephemeral token with smaller size (our SDK supports token exchange via /v1/session). If you prefer not to change client code immediately, consider URL-safe header compression or trimming extra metadata from the Authorization header.
- Add exponential backoff (100ms, 300ms, 900ms) on retries for 5xx.

2) Medium-term (1-2 weeks):
- We'll raise a config change to allow larger header sizes at the edge LB. I'll open INFRA-1278 and include repro sampling ids.
- We'll also add a note to the SDK docs for proxy setups and common header rewrite pitfalls.

Camila will run a quick end-to-end test if you can provision a short-lived staging token (Priya, can you share?). If you prefer, we can also do a joint screen share to test.

Thanks,
Camila
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Integration follow-up - SDK auth & 5xx repro

Quick update after a run against the staging token 


1) Repro: using Priya's token we triggered the same 502 edge error when Authorization header length > 1024. Sampling ids: samp-20270630-01, samp-20270630-02 (see attached repro-logs.txt).
2) Workaround success: trimming header to under 512 chars + adding exponential backoff eliminated the 5xx in our 15 minute load test (200 qps burst).
3) Reranker note: we saw no score drift after retry changes; embeddings and reranker latency met expected p95 under the trimmed-header setup.

Next steps:
- Camila: propose language for the SDK docs around proxy header size and token exchange flow.
- Neha: open INFRA-1278 with sampling ids and request that edge LB remove strict header size limit for internal customers (low priority but tracked).
- Marissa: follow up with Alex on acceptance criteria and confirm whether they want the LB change or client-side token exchange.

I'll attach the short test log (repro-logs.txt) and the sample request (request-sample.json) in the thread.

Dylan
Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
